你們的賞賜就必大了，
你們也必作至高者的兒子；
因為他恩待那忘恩的和作惡的。
But love your enemies
and do good
and lend

and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
But be loving to those who are against you and do them good
and give them your money
not giving up hope
and your reward will be great and you will be the sons of the Most High: for he is kind to evil men
and to those who have hard hearts.
